name: What should I prepare for a successful 1031 exchange in Florida?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare for a successful 1031 exchange in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a successful 1031 exchange in Florida, you should first consult with a qualified intermediary and a tax advisor to confirm your eligibility and understand the requirements. Gather all relevant documentation for your relinquished property, including appraisals, financial statements, and deeds. Be ready to act quickly to identify and close on replacement properties within the strict 45-day and 180-day deadlines. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution advises clients to have a clear investment strategy and pre-approved financing to enhance readiness in competitive markets like Miami or Fort Lauderdale.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by consulting with a qualified intermediary and tax advisor, gathering property documentation, and having a clear investment strategy for prompt action.
